description: Evidence-first debugging in 5 stages — REPRODUCE, EVIDENCE, DIAGNOSE, FIX, PROVE. Never touch code before the root cause is stated with evidence; fix the source, not the symptom; hand dead-end investigations to the root-cause-debugger agent. Use for any bug, error, crash, regression, unexpected behavior, or /toh-fix work.
